content: Adiy duw Juw dayadiy sapakwa nyanugw day maaj lakatiydiy Jisasaam viyasipak.
Jisas kidiy maaj wakuw, dikidiy kalivadidiy duwak wadidiy,
“Gwur lakwugwura nyi vitiy yakuw, nuwukadiy Juwawa nyan God Nyigirdidiy bayaki kikipaat kikibana. A nyaam, duw nak ata wunadiy mama nibak kwiy-kidadiwun day wunaam maap tinadi miyaam katadakik.”
Sapakwa nyanugw pris awa Juw dayadiy sapakwa nyanugw day vagaluwdiy Kayapas, Mwiya Yitaypika Pris diki wiyaam.
Day maaj awarwa lakatiydiy, “Atatawa nyan pakwun yin Jisasaam kalakwukuw, viyasipa-kibanaad?” Ata wadiy.
Aw day wadiy, “Bayaki nyaam nyan atawa kwar maa, ababa duw taakw pitaan warik-nadiy.”
Taakw nak viyakita waliy guw Jisas diki abwaam kaykwatakalid.
Jisas Jiruwsalim wapakuw, yikuw, adi tayir lepa tidi duw, Sayman, diki wiyaam kwaad Bitaniy tipaam.

Kikipaat kidik, taakw nak tukwul vaak yataan wulaal yala wiyaar. Adi tukwul vaak, yala vakaam, waliy guw tal. Saan samasam yapiy-kwadanaad. Li wulakuw, adi viyakita yaam yayda waliy guw Jisas abwaam kaykwatakalid.

Jisas dikidiy kalivadidiy duw a jaav vikuw, mawul wardiy. Day nikim nikim bwuladiy, “Agwa javik tikuw, ki waliy guw kip yakila? Yawiyik ti wiy ata yapiy-kwadiy. Aad saan samasam yapiy-kwadanaad. Adiy saan saal yinadiy duwak kwiykwa.”
Jisas daya maaj lakwukuw, wadidiy, “Agwa javik tikuw, sapis jikigwura likik? Kal viyakita jaava wunak kwurla.
“Saal yinadiy duw nyanyi gwurawa kwakwanadiy. Aw wun gwurawa nyanyi kwu maa.
“Li waliy guw taay wunaam kaykwatakakuw, aw ginyir kawaam takakidanadiwun. A javik wunak kwurla. Wun kawamiyaam kwakituwalik wunaam kwulapwulaala.
“Mwiya maaj watuwadiygwurik. Ginyir God diki viyakita maaj kwiydaak ababa tipaam, day ki kwurla javik wakinadiy. Duw taakw wukimar maa likik.”
Juwtas maaj lakatiydil di Jisasaam dikidiy mama nib daya tabaam takatakak.
Juwtas Yiskariyat, Jisas dikidiy tabatiy maan vitiya duw nak-ad, di sapakwa nyanugw pris ak yad.
Yikuw, wadidiy, “Aw wun Jisas gwurak kwatiya-kituwa, saan kwas kwiy-kigwuradiwun?” Aw day saan duwamiy nak sap tabatiy nasikuw, ata kwiydaad. (Nibwul adiy saan jilig tabatiy maan vitiy kitik).
Juwtas Jisas dayak kwiy nyak ata kwaki-bagwud.
Jisas God.
Taay nyaam, Yis Maa Ti Bret bayaki kikipata nyaam, a nyi Jisas dikidiy kalivadidiy duw dikik bas sidaad, “Akim nyan yikuw, mina bayaki kikipaat kwulapwu-kinadiyan kiminkikik?”

Jisas ata wadidiy, “Nimadi tip Jiruwsalimaar yikuw, gwur duw nikik aw, ‘Kalivadidiy duw wanaad, Wuna nyi aka walibab tina. Wun wunadiy kaliva-tuwadiy duwawa God Nyigirdidiy Nyi bayaki kikipaat kikir mina wiyaam.’”
Jisas dikidiy kalivadidiy duw atawa kwurdaak, God Nyigirdidiy Nyi bayaki kikipaat ata kwulapwu-daad.
Giraab kwusilik, Jisas dikidiy tabatiy maan vitiy duwawa daan ridiy bayaki kikipaat kikir.
Kikipaat kaan ridaak, Jisas ata wadidiy, “Mwiya maaj watuwadiygwurik. Gwura duw nak ginyir wunadiy mama nibak kwiykidadiwun.”
Dikidiy kalivadidiy duw pitaan warkuw, nakanak Jisasak bas sidaad, “Yitaypika Duw, wunak wanadimin?” wataay, wadaad.
Jisas ata wadidiy, “Adi duw wunawa bret marir bwutaay kwusin daanda. Di wunadiy mama nibak dayadiy tabaam kwiykidadiwun.

“Wun, duw taakw dayadi Mwaam, kiyakinadiwun, tayir God diki lapa nyig walil pik. Aw duw taakw dayadi Mwaam mama nibak kwiy-kinadi duw kupwarapa jaav dikim warkidanaad. Li tayir amaay kidi duw sapwiy maarlik, aal viyakita dikik.”
Juwtas ata waad, “Kalivanadi duw, min wunak wanadimin?” Jisas ata, “Ayiy,” wadid.
Komunion liki maaw.
Day kikipaat kidaak, Jisas bret kwurkuw, Godak wayapiy sidid. Jisas a bret kaysukwa-sukwakuw, dikidiy kalivadidiy duwak ata kwiydidiy. Di wadidiy, “Akwur. Kal wuna amwiya.”

Jisas adakap ata kwurkuw, Godak wayapiy sidid. A adakap dayak kwiydik, di ata wadidiy, “Gwur abab ak. Kad wunadi nyikiy-ad. Kidi nyikiy ababa duw takwak simakadadiy God diki aban mwiya maaja. Samasama duw takwak wunadi nyikiy wakwu-kinaad God dayadiy vaal yibwiydikik.
“Wun gwurak waaw. Nuwuka wain wun gwurawa ki maa. Aw ginyir God diki van tidi tamiyaam nuwuk wain gwurawa kikidiwun.”
Song nak tikuw, wiy wapakuw, day ata Aliv abwaar wardiy.
Jisas Pitaak wadid, “Ki gaan min ‘Wun Jisasaam maa laakw’ wakimina.”

Jisas dikidiy kalivadidiy duwak ata waad, “Ki gaan gwur abab wunaam wapakuw, tabwu-kinadiygwur. God diki lapa nyig ata wana, ‘God sipsip van tinadiy duwaam viyadik, kiyakinaad. Kiyadik, sipsip kapakap kapakap tabwu-kinadiy.’
“God wunaam kirapitakadik, tayib yikinadiwun Galiliyaar gwurak.”
Pita Jisasak ata wadid, “Li nuwukadiy tabwun wapakidadimin, wun minaam wap maa.”
Aw Jisas dikik ata waad, “Pita, min awuk! Ki gaan tapwuk wadik, tayir wakidimin jaab mugwul, ‘Wun Jisasaam maa laakw’ wakuw.”
Pita Jisasak maaj nimadib wadid, “Li wun minawa kiyakinadiwun ab, aw wun, ‘Jisasaam maa laakw,’ wu maa.” Dikidiy kalivadidiy duw day abab atawa wadiy.
Gitsiminiy tamiyaam Jisas Godawa maaj bwulaad.
Day yidadi tamiy si Gitsimaniy alir yidaak, Jisas dikidiy kalivadidiy duwak ata wadidiy, “Kilim kavin ada. Wun Godawa maaj bwulak yikidiwun.”
Jisas Pitawa Sipatiy dikibir nyidiy kwurin karaydidiy. Di ata pitaan warkuw, samasam wukid di dikik.
Di dayak ata wadidiy, “Wun wunak samasam wukinadiwun. Wukikuw, alik kiyak tinadiwun. Gwur kilim van ada wunawa.”

Di kwasa yikuw, kupwaam vakirid Godawa maaj bwulaak. Vakirkuw, Godak bas sidid, “Asaay, wunadi Asaay, ababa jaav kwur-kwaminadiy. Aw kidiy wunak yakinadiy kupwarapa javadiy kwurin ayak. Aw wuna mawul maa, min mina mawul.”
Jisas yakuw, vididiy dikidiy kalivadidiy duw mugwul day si kwadiy. Dayak wajawiyakuw, Pitaak wadid, “Gwur ri maarin kwasa mwiya pik van titak?
“Gwur van tan Godak maaj aw gwuraam vaal kakilik-na. Gwuradiy mawul yaakiya viyakita jaav kwurik, aw gwuradiy amwiy ap maa ti.”
Jaab vitiy warlik, Jisas maa ata yad Godak maaj bwulak. Di ata waad, “Wunadi Asaay, li kidiy wunak yakinadiy kupwarapa jaav wunaam wapaan yi maarkidana, a jaaw, yaakiya, kwurkituwadiy.”
Jisas dikidiy kalivadidiy duwak sibinin yakuw, vididiy si kwadaak. Dayadiy mil dibirin dibirin dadiy.
Jaab mugwul Jisas dayaam wapakuw, kwasa yikuw, Godak maaj wadid tayir wadidiy pik.

Jisas dikidiy kalivadidiy duwak sibinin yakuw, dayak wajawiyakuw, wadidiy, “Gwur si kwanadiygwur nibway? Ay yaakiya. Nyi aka walibab tina. Awuk! Duw nak yaan duw taakw dayadi Mwaam takakidaad vaal yinadiy duw daya tabaam.
“Gwur araap. Yinaak. Adi duw adi walibab tinaad.”
Jisas dikidiy mama nib dim kalakwudaad.

Wadik, Juwtas, Jisas dikidiy tabatiy maan vitiya duw nakad, dayak yaad. Juwtas wukin duw samasam yadiy. Wariya jaav kwurin kariyadadiy. Sapakwa nyanugw pris awa Juw dayadiy sapakwa nyanugw day wayakidaak, yadiy.
Jisasaam dayak kwiydi duw tayir wadidiy, “Mwutaam jipwu-kituwadi duw, adi duw gwur kwurik. Mwutaam jipwu-kituwadi duw adaanada ata akalakw.”
Juwtas yadik, Jisasak yakuw, wadid, “Sapakwa duw, kupwiyaay.” Wakuw, mwutaam ata jipwudid.
Jisas Juwtasak ata wadid, “Kapa duw, ki yawiyik yaminaala akwur.” Wakuw wadik, nuwukadiy duw yakuw, Jisasaam kaykitikuw, kalakwu-daad.
Jisasawa tidi duw wariya bag kaykitikuw, yitaypika pris dikidi yawiy duw diki waan viyalupwadil.
Jisas ata wadid, “Wada minadi wariya bag kwusadamin diki tamiyab kwakwaad. Adiy wariya bagaar wariya-kwanadiy duw atampik wariya bagaar nuwukadiy duw dayaam viyadaak kiya-kinadiy.
“Min maa laakw wunadi Asayik bas sikuw, di yabiyib dikidiy samasama maaj kardadiy duw wayaki-kidadiy day wunak sugwiyaan kwurdakik?
“Aw ata ata God diki lapa nyigaam rina maaj maykaar wakwukina? Li wana day kidiy jaav kwurkidanadiy wakuw.”

Vagaluwdiy duwak Jisas ata bas sididiy, “Wun jaal dayikwada duw-adiwun, gwur wariya jaav bag kwurkuw, wunaam kalakwuk yagwura? Nyi samasam God dikid wiyaam daan rituwdiy duw takwak kalivaan. Aw gwur wunaam maa kalakw.

“Wadiy wunaam kwur-gwuradiy jaav tayir God diki maaj wasapwiydiy duw God diki lapa nyigaam sukwudil maaj aka maykaar wakwuna.” Aw Jisas dikidiy kalivadidiy duw Jisas diki maaj wukikuw, dim wapakuw, day abab tabwudiy.
Day Jisasaam kotiydaad.
Adiy Jisasaam kalakwudiy duw day Jisasaam kwurin karaydaad Mwiya Yitaypika Pris, Kayapas, diki wiyaar. Alim God diki lo kalivadiy duwawa Juw dayadiy sapakwa nyanugw vagaluwdiy.

Jisasawa nuwukadiy duw day taay yidaak, Pita kwasa kwukil yikuw, Mwiya Yitaypika Pris diki wiya yaripaar ata yad. Yala yaripaar wulakuw, Pita van tidiy duwawa daan rad. Di vikir agwa jaav day Jisasaam kwurkidanaad.
Sapakwa nyanugw pris awa ababa kaunsil duw day wukik nuwukadiy duw suwaal maaj wadiy Jisasak. Wukikuw, day ata, “Di kiyakwaad,” wakir a majik. Alik kavidiy.
Duw samasam suwaal takadiy Jisasak aw day atampika maaj wawak maa rav. Duw vitiy ata yin wabir, “Kidi duw waad, ‘God dikidi wiy miyawa pira-kituwaad. Nyi vitiy yilik, wiy kwurkituwaad maa.’”
Mwiya Yitaypika Pris rapikuw, Jisasak bas sidid, “Kidiy duw minak sukwupirkuw wadana, aw min maaj maa ti?”
Aw Jisas kaygan tad. Maaj maa bwul. Adi Mwiya Yitaypika Pris ata Jisasak wadid maa, “Adawul nimadi God dikidi saam nyanak aw, min God dikidi Tasakwudidi Duw-adimin? God dikidi Nyan-adimin?”

Jisas ata wadid, “Ayiy, wamina maja pik. Aw wun minak waaw, ginyir gwur abab duw taakw dayadi Mwaam vikigwuraad, di ap samasam tinadi God diki mava tabaam mwiya yitaypika duw tamiyaam ridik. Gwur ata vikigwuraad, di adawul tubwaar yadik.”

A maaj wukikuw, Mwiya Yitaypika Pris yaal samasam girakuw, di dikidi wapwiy kaypirikiykuw, nimadib ata wadidiy, “Di Godak wajibaynaad! Nyan niki maaj wukik maa. Gwur diki sapis jikidi maaj Godak bwu wukigwura.
“Gwur agwa jaav kwurik dikim?” Day abab maa wakuw dikik, alik, “Kiyakwaad” wakuw, wadiy.
Adiy duw ata Jisas mwutamaam likasip satakaan taab kaygipwun viyaan kwurdaad. Aw nuwukadiy yala tabaar viyadaad.
Adiy Jisasaam viyadiy duw ata bas sidaad, “Min God dikidi Tasakwudidi Duw-adimin. God minak ap bwu kwiydil miyawa jaav lakwu-minakik, ay? Alik tikuw, nyanak aw. Sikanadaad minaam viyanaad?”
Pita nuwukadiy duw takwak, “Wun Jisasaam maa laakw” wakuw wadidiy.
A nyi Pita kawaam mala wiyaam kwadik, Mwiya Yitaypika Pris diki yawiy kwurla taakw dikik yakuw, ata walid, “Minabab Jisas Galiliy tamiy kidawa kwadimin.”
Li ata walik, di daya mwutamaam maa waad. Di ata waad, “Wun maa laakw wa wanyina maaj.”
Pita, yala yaripa wiyigaam wulakuw ridik, niki yawiy taakw dim vikuw, walibab tidiy duwak walidiy, “Kidi duw, di Jisas Nasarit tipa kidawa tikwanaad.”
Pita ki majib maa wakuw, nimadib wadidiy, “Mwiya maaj watuwadiygwurik, wun kidi duw maa laakw.”
Kwasa rikuw, walibab tidiy duw Pitaak yakuw, wadaad, “Min Jisas dikidiy duw nak min-adimin. Nyan wa bwulamina bwula majib lakwu-banadimin. Min Galiliy tamiya kid-adimin.”
Pita ata kupwarapa maaj wakuw, wadidiy, “Wuna maaj mwiyir ti maarlik, God wunaam viyakwaad. Wun gwur wadi duw wun maa laakw.” Ata wadik, tapwuk ata waad.
Pita, Jisas tayir wadil maaj wukidil, “Tapwuk wadik, taay min jaab mugwul wakimina, ‘Wun Jisas maa laakw.’” Wukikuw, kawaar wakwukuw, Pita ata nimadib giraad.
